## Goal

Target: site `6ad6405eae8eac6d7b7c41a3`, the `/style-guide` page and the variable collections.

## Steps

1. Read-only first: `variable_tool > get_variable_collections` and the variables in each, plus `style_tool > get_styles(query: "all")`. Record the live names.
2. Compare with `figma/tokens.json` `mapping.colors`, `mapping.fontVariables` and `mapping.typography` (targets are proposals from `docs/reference/style-guide.md`). Note every target that does not exist live.
